entities.summary: Basile Georges Casmoussa is a Syriac Catholic prelate who served as Apostolic Visitor of the Syrian Catholics in Western Europe from 2014 to 2017. He previously served as Archbishop of Mosul from 1999 to 2010 and as a curial official for the Patriarchate of Antioch from 2011 to 2014.
